During a '''battle''' at the [[Koda Space Station]], the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] defeated the forces of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. The battle was part of the larger [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="EA ">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
